# Let's Roll Garage Doors

> Let's Roll Garage Doors is a garage door repair, installation, and maintenance company based in Austin, Texas. We provide 24/7 emergency service, spring and cable repair, opener installation, and new garage door installation for residential and commercial customers across the greater Austin metro area.

Let's Roll Garage Doors serves Austin, TX homeowners and businesses with fast, transparent, and professional garage door service. We are licensed, insured, and available around the clock for emergency repairs.

## Company Info

- Business name: Let's Roll Garage Doors
- Location: Austin, Texas, USA
- Phone: (512) 947-4451
- Email: letsrollgaragedoors@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 24 hours (emergency service always available)
- Service area: Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Kyle, Buda, Lakeway, Leander, Hutto, Manor, Bastrop

## Services

- Garage Door Repair (same-day service)
- New Garage Door Installation (steel, wood composite, aluminum; single and double car)
- Garage Door Opener Repair & Installation (LiftMaster, Chamberlain, Genie, Craftsman)
- Garage Door Spring Replacement (torsion and extension springs; single and two-spring systems)
- Garage Door Cable Repair (frayed and broken cables)
- Garage Door Roller Replacement (standard and nylon rollers)
- Garage Door Tune-Up & Maintenance (lubrication, balance check, safety inspection)
- 24/7 Emergency Garage Door Service (under 60-minute average response in Austin)

## Pricing (Austin, TX — 2026)

- Spring replacement: $150–$250 single spring, $200–$350 two-spring system
- Opener repair: $75–$125 minor (sensor alignment, remote reprogramming); $150–$250 motor replacement
- New opener installation: $380–$750 installed depending on model
- Cable replacement: $100–$200
- New door installation: $800–$1,200 basic single-car; $1,500–$2,500+ premium or double-car
- Roller & hinge replacement: $75–$150
- After-hours/emergency service fee: $50–$100 (disclosed upfront)
- Free estimates: Yes, no obligation

## Brands Serviced

- Garage door openers: LiftMaster, Chamberlain, Genie, Craftsman
- Garage door manufacturers: Clopay, Wayne Dalton, Amarr, and all major brands
- Smart opener compatibility: LiftMaster myQ, Aladdin Connect, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit
